metadata.question: Does vegetation greenness (NDVI) in Toliara, Madagascar on average decrease during September 2021-2022 compared to the 2000-2015 average for the same period?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Location: Toliara, Madagascar (approximately -23.35°S, 43.67°E) - Two time periods: September 2021-2022 vs September 2000-2015 - Collection: MODIS NDVI (MOD13Q1 or MOD13A1) for long-term comparison - 16-day composite, good for multi-year analysis - Band: NDVI 2. Masking strategy: - MODIS NDVI products have quality bands - should apply basic quality filtering - Use pixel reliability or summary QA to filter poor quality pixels - The question asks about vegetation greenness change, not clouds 3. Logic to distinguish Valid Zero vs Null/Error: - Valid NDVI range: -1 to 1 (typically vegetation is 0.2-0.8) - NDVI near 0 or slightly negative could be valid (bare soil, sparse vegetation) - Need to check: collection size, valid pixel count after masking, and whether results are None/NaN - Compare means: if 2021-2022 < 2000-2015, answer is A (Yes, decreased), otherwise B (No) ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions const toliara = ee.Geometry.Point([43.67, -23.35]); const region = toliara.buffer(10000); // 10km buffer around Toliara // 2. Data Acquisition & Check // Historical period: September 2000-2015 const historicalStart = '2000-09-01'; const historicalEnd = '2015-09-30'; // Recent period: September 2021-2022 const recentStart = '2021-09-01'; const recentEnd = '2022-09-30'; // Use MODIS Terra Vegetation Indices 16-Day Global 250m const modisCollection = 'MODIS/006/MOD13Q1'; // Quality masking function function maskQuality(image) { const qa = image.select('SummaryQA'); // Keep only good quality pixels (0 = good, 1 = marginal) const mask = qa.lte(1); return image.updateMask(mask).select('NDVI').multiply(0.0001); // Scale factor } // Historical collection const historicalCol = ee.ImageCollection(modisCollection) .filterBounds(region) .filterDate(historicalStart, historicalEnd) .map(maskQuality); const historicalSize = historicalCol.size().getInfo(); console.log(`Historical images (2000-2015): ${historicalSize}`); if (historicalSize === 0) { console.log('No historical data found.'); console.log('C1'); return; } // Recent collection const recentCol = ee.ImageCollection(modisCollection) .filterBounds(region) .filterDate(recentStart, recentEnd) .map(maskQuality); const recentSize = recentCol.size().getInfo(); console.log(`Recent images (2021-2022): ${recentSize}`); if (recentSize === 0) { console.log('No recent data found.'); console.log('C1'); return; } // 3. Processing - Calculate mean NDVI for each period const historicalMean = historicalCol.mean(); const recentMean = recentCol.mean(); // Check valid pixel counts const historicalCount = historicalMean.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: region, scale: 3000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('NDVI').getInfo(); const recentCount = recentMean.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: region, scale: 3000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('NDVI').getInfo(); console.log(`Historical valid pixels: ${historicalCount}`); console.log(`Recent valid pixels: ${recentCount}`); if (historicalCount === 0 || recentCount === 0) { console.log('No valid pixels after quality masking.'); console.log('C2'); return; } // 4. Calculation - Get mean NDVI values const historicalNDVI = historicalMean.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: region, scale: 3000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('NDVI').getInfo(); const recentNDVI = recentMean.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: region, scale: 3000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('NDVI').getInfo(); // 5. Validation & Final Answer console.log(`Historical NDVI (2000-2015 Sep): ${historicalNDVI?.toFixed(4)}`); console.log(`Recent NDVI (2021-2022 Sep): ${recentNDVI?.toFixed(4)}`); if (historicalNDVI === null || recentNDVI === null || isNaN(historicalNDVI) || isNaN(recentNDVI) || historicalNDVI < -1 || historicalNDVI > 1 || recentNDVI < -1 || recentNDVI > 1) { console.log('Invalid NDVI calculation.'); console.log('C3'); return; } const change = recentNDVI - historicalNDVI; console.log(`NDVI Change: ${change.toFixed(4)}`); if (recentNDVI < historicalNDVI) { console.log('Vegetation greenness decreased.'); console.log('A'); } else { console.log('Vegetation greenness did not decrease.'); console.log('B'); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
